title: Effective-dating primitives
description: Shared $defs for every control-plane registry. Mechanism per spec Section 63.1: state transitions with start_date and end_date, effective-dating, never in-place mutation. Rules C1-C5 and A1-A6 of schemas/registry/CONVENTIONS.md.

stableId.title: Stable identifier, never reused (Sections 7, 63.1; rule A1)

ianaTimezone.title: IANA timezone identifier, never a UTC offset (Section 7.3; rule C5)

effectiveInterval.title: An effective-dated interval
effectiveInterval.description: end_date is always present; null means open-ended (rule C2). Non-employees must carry a non-null end_date (rule C3, Section 7.1).
